title: Lévy distance between measures
statement:
For measures $\mu$ and $
u$ on $\mathbb R$, define their Lévy distance to be the infimum of all real numbers $\varepsilon \ge 0$ such that, for every $u \in \mathbb R$, the measure of $(-\infty,u-\varepsilon]$ under $
u$, converted to a real number and then decreased by $\varepsilon$, is at most the measure of $(-\infty,u]$ under $\mu$, converted to a real number, and that latter quantity is at most the measure of $(-\infty,u+\varepsilon]$ under $
u$, converted to a real number and then increased by $\varepsilon$.
